profile.goodFor: sweeps and tone shaping: cutting lows or highs, filter sweeps and wobbles moved by an LFO or the level

settings.name: Cutoff
settings.what: where the filter starts to cut

settings.name: Type
settings.what: which part it keeps: low pass keeps the lows, high pass the highs, band pass the middle, notch removes a narrow band

settings.name: Resonance
settings.what: boost at the cutoff; high values whistle

settings.name: Slope
settings.what: how steeply it cuts past the cutoff

settings.name: LFO amount
settings.what: how far the LFO moves the cutoff; negative moves it down

settings.name: LFO sync
settings.what: LFO speed following the song's tempo, or free in Hz

settings.name: LFO length
settings.what: one LFO cycle in note lengths, when synced to the tempo

settings.name: LFO rate
settings.what: LFO speed in Hz, when free

settings.name: Envelope amount
settings.what: how far the input's level moves the cutoff (auto-wah); negative closes it

settings.name: Envelope attack
settings.what: how fast the cutoff follows a rise in level
